name: Gorilla Kingdom
summary: Gorilla Kingdom is a fast-paced VR multiplayer experience where you swing, climb, and leap through immersive environments as a gorilla. Compete with friends, explore vast maps, and show off your unique style with customizable cosmetics. Whether you're chasing others in intense tag modes or just vibing in the treetops, Gorilla Kingdom delivers non-stop action, freedom of movement, and community-driven fun. Rule the jungle this is your kingdom.
